tagline: 美能达便携相机，1996 年发布
description: 美能达于1996年推出的便携相机。配备25mm 1:4 with 3 elements in 3 groups (equivalent to a 30mm lens for 35mm film)。快门速度electronically controlled shutter with speeds 1/4 to 1/350 sec.。active infrared。

specs.镜头: 25mm 1:4 with 3 elements in 3 groups (equivalent to a 30mm lens for 35mm film)
specs.快门: electronically controlled shutter with speeds 1/4 to 1/350 sec.
specs.取景器: reverse Galilean real image finder, framed depending on chosen exposure format
specs.闪光灯: built-in, modes off, on, automatic, night portrait and anti-red-eye
specs.英文简介: The Minolta Vectis UC is a compact camera of Minolta's Vectis series for the Advanced Photo System.
